explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 88 named tracks across current August–September 2026 Boomkat, Bandcamp and Third Room windows, Bandcamp Daily's August electronic survey, adjacent/emerging label trails and overlooked catalogue material. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The repaired opening was excluded from placement testing: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback, while Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained by direct listener evidence.
Completed Runs 221, 222, 223, 225 and 227 selected identities and tested boundaries were excluded; unresolved, duplicate, rejected and untriggered PARKED identities were not reused.

Every artist/title pair below was checked against the canonical ledger, discoveries, target-local discovery pool, active rejections, PARKED revisit queue and global utility ledger before ranking; none was present.

The repetition check found no proposed boundary matching a selected-candidate boundary from the previous five completed discovery runs. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both protected handoffs remain untouched.

The three strongest leads come from three releases and carry candidate-specific rhythmic or developmental evidence. Lower-ranked leads preserve exact-track evidence limits rather than inventing individual behaviour. Nine honest leads survived without padding; no Spotify connector or metadata-to-feeling inference was used.
rankedLeadSummary: 8. Automatisme & Stefan Paulus — Signal Body (Torpor Space)
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Third Room's Curation Three: Verraco, DJ Carpenter's Tatiana, Groove Armada's Body Action and Immersion's Megafauna, checked 2026-09-14. https://www.thethirdroom.de/label/t3r023-curation-three-verraco.html ; https://steelcitydancediscs.bandcamp.com/track/tatiana ; https://groovearmada.bandcamp.com/album/body-action ; https://www.destroyexist.com/2026/06/immersion-megafauna.html
